scope: Independent local server lifecycle and client-priority assessment; no UI completion claim

service_acceptance.scope: local detached service, synthetic media, not UI or rendering performance
checks: start returned ready after launcher exited
repeat start retained the same instance
background worker completed real FFmpeg frame job after submitter exit
authenticated artifact download matched hash and independently expected blue pixels
ten separate status clients found service ready
Bearer/Origin/Host on all methods, browser preflight/header exposure, mandatory initialization
Session initialization, newer-version negotiation, discovery parity, version/Accept/body bounds
Actual create/CLI persistence, resource parity and immutable prompt via Streamable HTTP
Disconnected POST still commits; replay returns only its original response; cross-session/unknown cursors rejected
Resource notifications survive GET disconnect; bounded stream replay explicitly expires after retention overflow
DELETE closes active SSE and invalidates one session while another remains usable
MCP CLI transport alias and real idle-session expiry
32-session admission bound and released slot reuse
SIGINT shuts down active HTTP/SSE sessions and the shared host

limitations: No automatic OS startup or crash restart installed
No Web/Desktop interaction or playback performance acceptance
Readiness checks API and storage; it is not a continuous worker heartbeat or a render performance benchmark
